name: Machine Decline Chest Press
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles align with your lower chest and plant your feet on the floor.
Press your upper back against the pad and grasp the handles with straight wrists.
Press the handles forward and slightly downward along the machine path until your arms are extended.
Lower the handles slowly back to a controlled chest stretch without letting the weight stack touch down.
tips: Keep your shoulders anchored down away from your ears throughout the press.
Avoid bouncing at the back of the range; pause gently before pressing again.
